title: [SW] Aether Tweaks
description: Simplifies Aether accessories to capes + gloves, replaces survival inventory with accessories screen, and restricts Sun Altar to OP players.
body:
# [SW] Aether Tweaks

A lightweight addon for **The Aether** that simplifies its accessory system and improves gameplay flow.

---

## Features

### Sun Altar changes

* Only OP players can change time
* Non-OP players receive a denial message
* Aether time progression is disabled

---

### Simplified accessories system

The accessory system is reduced to:

* Capes
* Gloves

All other accessory categories are removed completely.

Additionally:

* `Shield of Repulsion` is treated as a cape

---

### Inventory rework

#### Survival players

* Opening inventory redirects to the accessories screen
* Crafting grid remains available
* Custom XP display is shown:

  ```
  XP: <player level>
  ```

#### Creative inventory

* Two additional accessory slots are available
